mapper.sql: select r.repository_id, r.project_id, r.name, r.slug, r.disk_path, r.default_branch, r.visibility, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark, p.project_key, t.team_key, coalesce(ugr.collect, 0) as collect from sys_git_repository r inner join sys_project p on r.project_id = p.project_id and p.project_state > 0 inner join sys_team t on p.team_id = t.team_id left join sys_user_git_repository ugr on r.repository_id = ugr.repository_id and ugr.user_id = #{params.userId}
